== Notes ==
* This is a very useful skill for [[melee]], as they will often be within touch range of a foe and because it can remove blindness.
* This is a skill, not a spell, and is therefore unaffected by [[Dazed]].

== Trivia == 
* The [[skill icon]] has the same hand silhouette as [[Echo]].
